test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Rishika travels a certain distance at a speed of 52 km/hr and double the earlier distance at 39 km/hr. She then returns to the starting point through the same route. If her average speed for the entire journey is 56 km/h, then what is her speed (in km/hr) for the return journey?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the initial distance be **156 km** (LCM of 52 and 39). Total distance for outward journey = 156 + 2 × 156 = 468 km.

Outward time = (156 ÷ 52) + (312 ÷ 39) = 3 + 8 = **11 hours**.

Total journey distance (out + return) = 468 × 2 = **936 km**. Total time = 936 ÷ 56 = **117/7 hours**.

Return time = 117/7 − 11 = (117 − 77)/7 = **40/7 hours**.

Return Speed = 468 ÷ (40/7) = (468 × 7) ÷ 40 = 3276 ÷ 40 = **81.9 km/hr**.

**∴ The correct answer is 81.9 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9306f383fe0a30e5e9ef0c48ed871b2e6b2bc4354a0a68be9a8f41bd088ca4e3.png] 

**Given:** Speed 1 = 52 km/h, Distance 1 = D; Speed 2 = 39 km/h, Distance 2 = 2D; Average Speed = 56 km/h.

**Formula:** Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Total Distance = D + 2D + 3D (Return) = 6D

⇒ Total Time = (D/52) + (2D/39) + (3D/v)

⇒ 56 = 6D / [(D/52) + (2D/39) + (3D/v)]

⇒ 56 = 6 / [(3/156) + (8/156) + (3/v)]

⇒ 56 = 6 / [11/156 + 3/v]

⇒ 11/156 + 3/v = 6/56 = 3/28

⇒ 3/v = 3/28 − 11/156 = (3 × 39 − 11 × 7) / 1092 = (117 − 77) / 1092

⇒ 3/v = 40 / 1092

⇒ v = (1092 × 3) / 40 = 3276 / 40 = 81.9 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 81.9 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed (Equal Distances)

When two equal distances are covered at speeds u and v, Average Speed = 2uv / (u + v). For three equal distances, it is 3uvw / (uv + vw + wu).

Weighted Average Speed

If distances d₁, d₂,... are covered at speeds v₁, v₂,..., Average Speed = (Σdᵢ) / (Σdᵢ/vᵢ).

Time & Distance Relation

Distance = Speed × Time. If distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time (v₁/v₂ = t₂/t₁).</p
